text:
Came here by mistake  took 20+ minutes for them to make four sushi rolls. Gave my order, they repeated it back correctly, and then received one roll less than we had ordered. 

Out of the five tables here one other had sushi. Bathroom had no paper towels or toilet paper
Cool place,  great coffee, great service,  a little inconsistency.  All in all great, bright, fun place to do work and enjoy a good coffee.
Ordered Takoyaki and it was amazing!  Just like I had in Japan!  Quick pickup and great food!

This place is SOOOOO good. I am now dreaming about it at work. How did I not see this place before? I drive by everyday to work. Anyway, we came here during the covid time, and we were the only one in the dining area.  We were quickly greeted and seated. As soon as we ordered, the server brought chips and salsa out and wow I'm not sure if it's because I haven't had good chips and salsa for so long. But these chips and salsa are so good. Me and my coworker finished it within 5 minutes, it's ridiculous. My coworker ordered chimichanga and I ordered Tacos Mexicanos - Asada taco, chicken taco, and pastor. We both were so happy we came here. I have to come back again with my fiance. My new favorite Mexican restaurant along side with El Primo.

Stopped in for lunch. Easy to find but back off the road a bit. Plenty of parking. Interesting friendly greeter:). It is your basic buffet offering with hibachi grill. Flavor was ok but nothing that would make me look forward to coming back. Seemed to be about average on cleanliness.

Last week I brought my lunch to work, but something greater was calling me. And it wasn't the lobster mac in my lunch bag.

I was really craving a fried chicken sandwich. And it just so happens that the Bonafried food truck was parked right outside of my job! 

Truthfully, I wanted to try Bonafried's entire menu. (I'm still committed to this, actually) Their sandwiches sounded just that good. Simple ingredients while the chicken is packed with flavor! I went with The Southern: pickles and honey topped the massive piece of boneless chicken thighs between two super soft buns. I immediately fell in love. The crispiness of the chicken, sweetness of the honey and tangy taste of pickle all combined so well on this sandwich! Service was also pretty speedy and it was lunchtime in the CBD so I was impressed.

Needless to say, I'm a total Bonafried fangirl and I can't want to cheat on my diet with them again!

So today I was looking for a nice place to eat and I stumbled upon this restaurant. This place is semi fancy and a great place for a date. They're food is decent and there service is good and on Fridays (which was the day I went) they have a guy singing classic songs for entertainment. Their atmosphere is good as well. Overall a solid restaurant that earns (if it was a choice) 3 and a half stars. By the way this place is VERY expensive.

Absolutely fantastic Korean food.  I get the beef bugolgi soup, which has the perfect balance of salt, sweet, and savoriness.  It's the type of dish that I only crave MORE after eating it.  Maybe its the salt and sugar.  Who cares - it's awesome!

I had an appointment in the little shopping strip off of Moana and asked them about this establishment they said it was awesome food. I decided to give them a try. The staff was absolutely helpful and I decided to order an All American Burger and a side of potato salad. I took it to go so unfortunately I was heading to work so I'm not allowed phones in my job to take pictures.

The burger had cheese and bacon plus all the fixings...it was absolutely delicious and the potato salad was bomb! I wish I could have taken pictures but I will be visiting them again! The burger was 4.99 and potato salad was 3.00! Omg it was a party in my mouth. I can't wait to stop in again and I'll get you some pics of food. I highly recommend as they have so many options with burgers, hot dogs made in different ways! Check them out, they are locally owned and could always use your business! Try the potato salad, next time I'll try fries bcuz they looked so fresh and yummy!

I love this Indian restaurant. The buffet used to be a fun treat pre-Covid and thanks to the buffet I discovered how amazing their lentil dishes taste. Since Covid we've ordered 2x from the menu and everything was excellent...the Chicken 65 and biryani really stood out in our last order as delicious dishes. I think they serve the best Indian food in Nashville and the surrounding area. I have to take a star away because when you dine in the staff will hustle you out once you pay and we've even gotten the check before the waiter asked if we were finished because they wanted our table. Do not expect a leisure meal where you can linger.

The Brisket Cheesesteak might be one of the 10 best sandwiches I've ever had in my life. Great roll, juicy and flavorful brisket, topped with a mix of cheese and fried onions. Very filling too, not all cheesesteaks in Philly fill you up. The house-made BBQ chips were also very good.

We had made reservations for dinner in advance but when we arrived they didn't have our reservation listed.  Instead of acknowledging that they had forgotten to write down our reservation they lied and said our name was on another list. They then cleared off a table they were using as office space which is located right next to the bathroom hallway, just adjacent to the walkway to the bar and kitchen and another dining room and just across from their waitstaff supply area. So the foot traffic and noise would be horrendous.  The booth seats were so uncomfortable, lumpy and stiff. 
Now mind you, our reservation was for 4:45pm. There are only two other tables occupied. Our table wasn't even set up for customers. All the other tables were setup and empty. When I complained, I was told we had been  seated at their most popular and most requested table.  
If that is true, why wasn't it already setup and reserved for the night. I was told it would take time to relocate us to another table. What?  It would only take a second to escort us to another table.  So first you lie, you don't even apologize for your oversight then you treat us as if we aren't worthy of eating at your establishment. 
Sorry, but I will not grace you my business. It takes but one second to make a smart business decision to treat your customers with respect.

Every time I go here, I try and get breakfast kolaches. They somehow are always out of them. I've gotten kolaches only once or twice and they were very good when I had them. I was told that they "sold out of them yesterday" and that they wouldn't have more for a couple of days, yet on their menu it says that they are "made fresh every morning." Clearly this is not the case. All the food on their menu is good, they just might be out of the best thing on their menu all the time.

Tasty, Good atmosphere, excellent place, excellent service, good prices, great music, heaven for vegetarians. 
I live in NY and it was my first visit to Apricot Stone and I love it.
 1.Food-  I am a vegetarian and they have plenty selection for vegetarians and vegans. I got trio( babaganush, motabal and beet salad walnuts. All three were incredibly tasty. I also got vegan Dolma with rice which was melty and very tasty. I got falafel with tahini as an entry, which was very well cooked, not oily and one of the best falafels I ever had. We got Pakhlava as a desert, which was good.  

2. Service- Excellent service, Anie was our waitress and she was very attentive and friendly. They don't have alcohol but you can bring yours.
 
3. Atmosphere-  Felt like being in Armenia.  Armenian and Greek music were playing through the speakers. Photos of Armenia all over the place. Even the salt and pepper shakers were from Armenia. I  am from Armenia and finding place like this was touching and emotional for me. The dining was outdoors but so warm that felt indoor. 

I would  also suggest to make a reservation in advance as the place has a lot of customers. 
I love this place and promise to go there every time I will be in Philly.  Thank you

Came up from Phoenix to visit, came across this little gem and glad I did! The restaurant has a beautiful charming feel to it and the food was excellent. Our server Nikki was engaging and quick always making sure we were attended too! I will definitely be coming back. Check out this sweet little spot if you haven't already.
Workers inside the restaurant is like a joke!! Not even dressed for work!! They look like they're at home. In his own living room.  Lol

We had a terrific experience- Jess was a wonderful waitperson...we had oysters (good, but a bit watery, not briny like you want) and calamari, which was excellent for our apps and lobster rolls, crab cakes and mussels - all of which were excellent.  Got fries with Old Bay seasoning - really good.  Kids had ice cream and husband housemade key lime pie...all were happy.  Work on the oysters...no reason to be watery!  Overall, a cute place and a good last night of vacation dinner!

The food was very expensive for a garbage meal. I got the shrimp scampi and the shrimp was surprisingly good however the pasta was so bland it was like they just dumped on some Italian seasonings and a little butter. My boyfriend got some sort of chicken breast sandwich and he said it was the worst food he's had in long time. We won't make that mistake again.

Who doesnt love Pho. This place has it made locally to provide the great food. They have levels of spice options and tastes that are fantastic. The egg rolls are great as well and great to enjoy with family. 

I highly recommend this place for an great vietnamese meal.

They Forgot half of order thru app order. I Didn't notice until I returned home. Tried calling but they said I need a manager who isn't there. It's good food, but be careful ordering online, double check your bag.
I LOVE this spot. Their asada, asadero, and rajas con queso are absolutely top notch. Have thoroughly enjoyed every of the many dishes I've eaten here, and their salsas are marvelous.
I attempted to use my Groupon and was denied. Manager of the store was very confrontational both times I was there. I will not be eating there again.

They dont have honey mustard. 

But its fine our server, TAYLOR, was phenomenal id party with him. I recommend the michalob ultra.

The pros: 
Lots of tourist cups (been there series) 

The cons: 
1. Can't walk inside and yes I know COVID, but all other Starbucks stores have accommodated and followed regulations in order to have guests inside so why hasn't this one? Especially with how huge it is and it's in prime location. 

2. No connections, no third place environment here you're more of an inconvenience to them. 

And lastly and most importantly, these baristas don't know their recipes...please refrain because at $6 a cup, the drink needs to be right. 

Partner to partner , get it together

One of my favorite places I've ever been. The price for all you can eat meats with hot sides is SO good. I only went there a few times and the staff remembered me and what I got last time. Amazingly delicious; I highly recommend!

Tbh gentrified Mexican food is always hit or miss and imma have to say this one def missed. I got the 3 tacos for $7-8 (I forgot the exact price) with chicken and corn tortilla because if you want to get carne asada (or several other meat options), it's an extra few dollars. They don't allow you to get single or double tacos, only sets of 3. You get to choose one sauce and any additional sauce is an extra 50 cents, which I thought was kind of whack LOL. Anyway the tacos themselves looked super loaded but most of it is lettuce, pico de gallo, and onions+cilantro. The cheese was shredded cheese (like the "3 color Mexican blend" from grocery stores) which is how you know it did not smack lmao. The chicken itself was fine but overall put together, it was a huge no :(
Good pizza joint with a variety of "different" menu options. Well made, not skimpy, and tasty!

I don't want to do this. I hate writing such a poor review.  I'm going to start with fees to get in. I paid $8 park.  I paid $10 to get in. Not sure what the VIP card means that has been given out.  Valet parking signs yet no Valet. Parking attendants were rude. I get it, it's hot out, it's the weekend but your job is to assist people to park and they were super rude.  It was Saturday and only 1 bartender.  1 bar open and 1 bartender yet all the cabanas were rented. If you wanted food you had to order through the 1 bartender. Service bartender for cabanas wasn't helping. No barback?  Usually when I come I rent a cabana but I didn't know the service was so poor if you were trying to just come get food. The menu was HORRIBLE. 

I came to meet my neighbor who arrived by boat. They ordered food for me before I got there. Had no idea it would cost $18 to have the opportunity to eat really bad food with really poor service.  Sorry guys. Get it together

The bibimbap was exactly what I wanted and needed. Gawd I Iove that dish. It was prepared perfectly. I ordered off Yelp/Grubhub and picked up. You can park right in front on the street temporarily. Don't go to paid parking. Not necessary. Will make this a regular stop.

I've eaten American creole food in Tampa before and most times it's not that great but this place has some amazing authentic  creole food. I will be going here again and again and again. The owners are amazingly helpful and charming don't see that much any more when you go to Resturant.
Hairs in my food. Awful. The food was also cold and took forever. The crab Rangoon was hard as a rock. Definitely would not go back.
The wings are easily the best prepared I have ever had. I regret having waited so long to try this place

Just start by saying - THIS is the best burger in town. We generally order the "little" burger - smaller versions of the "regular" burger. Great selection of condiments to add to your burger. My wife orders her's "all the way" which includes a good selection of the toppings. I order mine more traditional with mustard, lettuce, tomato & pickle. They give you a ton of fries, so we just order a small usually. Crunchy on the outside & soft inside - perfect fries. Have ordered them cooked a little extra at a different location to make them more crispy. The milkshakes are fantastic - if you have a taste for one, don't miss them at Five Guys! They also have hot dogs, a grilled cheese, veggie sandwiches, and a BLT. After ordering the food - cooked to order, it came out quickly. Always a consistently great burger from location to location - don't miss Five Guys for a GREAT burger!

*revised* thanks to Brian the manager our order was corrected and he was genuinely apologetic. It seems it was an off night for both the person answering the phone and the kitchen. It's worth a 2nd visit just make sure and check the order of your doing take out

This is one of my favorite cheesesteak purveyors in Philadelphia. The ordering process is very simple and they have more offerings compared to other places that are strictly cheesesteaks. Along with the other food items you also have the choice of picking your cheese which makes this place stand out over Pat and Geno's. Sometimes I want provolone and sometimes I want cheez whiz so this place lets me explore my options. There's limited seating and it get busy pretty quickly so I'd suggest getting here early to snag a table. Overall I would recommend this place to someone that wants to enjoy their cheesesteak experience.

This place was really good.  But lately they are getting cheap.  Instead of romaine lettuce they are now using iceberg lettuce which is cheap,  no nutrition and water.  The ground beef is cold.  The pinto beans don't even look pinto. The guac is nasty brown. I don't know what happened.  They were not like that before. 

Also,  when I tell the server "little rice" I still get a glob of rice thrown in the bowl. They do not listen.

Worst service ever. Showed up with my group and was asked to make a reservation. I make the reservation. As soon as I'm done making it we get turned away saying they can't accommodate our reservation!!! When I was told specifically by them to make the damn reservation!!!!
Visiting from Atlanta this weekend I ate here twice already going back tomorrow before I leave everything was good Probably the best food I've had since in New Orleans

The kitchen really needs to figure out how to get everyone's food out close to the same time. One person out of 4 should not get there food and the rest of the party waiting another 10 minutes for their meals. Service is good and the building is beautiful but I won't return because of how bad our food was served time wise.

I stumbled upon the Cafe when someone mentioned their beignets on Twitter, so I took the half hour drive from PA to try them out. And it was a drive well worth it! The beignets had just the right amount of density, and the sugar was awesome. And they even lasted the drive home! I'd love to come back for a full breakfast.

This restaurant was clean and had friendly staff. I'm just not crazy bout the food or the prices. The fried rice isn't good. Our waitress forgot our spring rolls and when they arrived, the sauce was not even good. I like the spicy chicken and the Mongolian beef but it's way overpriced.

We came here for a weeknight dinner with a friend visiting from out of town. They seated us upstairs. It's quieter up there and more secluded. (If I came as a tourist, I'd probably want to sit downstairs or outside to get the full experience.)

They have a large menu of popular local fare and Italian options. We ordered the Chargrilled Oysters for an appetizer. The server must have forgotten though because they didn't come out until our entrees came out. Sadly, they were probably the worst I've ever had. They were under-cooked and still on the raw side. (Most likely a forgotten order that they rushed to grill on the fly.)

I started with a cup of the Chicken and Andouille Gumbo. It was ok. I got the Terranova Pizza as my entree. It was huge and I had plenty of leftovers. It was alright, but the whole bottom crust underneath had lots of burnt crumbs on it. (Most likely the pizza oven needs to be scraped out.)

My dining companions ordered a Fried Shrimp Plate and the Seafood Platter. They found both of their plates to be fine.

The staff were very friendly and helpful - despite bringing our Oysters too late.

I would order differently next time.

Nice ambiance, friendly service, creative use of common items such as speckled metal plates and mugs (like you might use for camping), lovely patio and $1 fish tacos on Mondays. What fun!  The food, fish and picadillo taco, blue corn quesadilla and flan were delish. For some tacos they form dough around the filling, kind of like an empanada and fry it. Best wishes to this new reataurant for a successful future. Cash only and no liquor license at this time.

Our first time there. Maybe an off night in the kitchen, or they were down a server or maybe that's how it always is? Our table of 4 was served apps/dinner after two other parties were seated after us? I had the Fradiavolo at $30, a very small plate, the tomato sauce was week and w/no flavor, light on scallops /shrimp, etc., and even pasta. My wife had Osso Buco at $32, one small piece of veal, in an over whelming red sauce, which would have been better served on my Fradiavolo...we also ordered garlic bread and when asked for more we agreed but had no idea we would get 4 orders total. With all the dining options in Lambertville, New  Hope and Stockton, we would be hard pressed to go back anytime soon

I don't frequent steakhouses so I just stuck to their price fix menu. It comes with choice of salad, a side and steak. The Caesar salad was perfectly tossed and had a lot of cheese shavings. My Oscar was decadently rich. This was served on sizzling hot plates that is placed in front of you. Had to remind myself, "Don't touch the plate!"

Covid standards followed here. Menu may have less variety and the sides are paired down to single servings. I'm sure this is temporary. The quality and taste of the meals are still there.

They offer an omelette, list the ingredients but forget to mention the bacon! We do not eat bacon yet it was not in the list of ingredients so there was no way we could tell them to take it out. I guess we need to go through everything they have and say we do not want...

The sticky bun French toast was burnt when brought to us.

The bread that came with our bacon-filled omelette was already buttered. We do NOT need you to butter or toast for us. We are perfectly capable of doing that ourselves. WHY would you ever butter somebody else's bread?!

We are new to Hatboro and noticed all the good things Hatboro dish was involved in during the pandemic shutdown.  Once things opened up we decided to try it for breakfast and it was great.  The staff were personable and attentive.  The food was delicious and the price was good.  We definitely look forward to making this a regular stop.
We tried to get pizza delivered but the delivery guy ditches us even as we were standing outside waiting. This was Saturday March 17 at 12am.

I almost do not want to write this review as I don't want everyone to know about this little jewel and make it difficult for us to get seated LOL.  There are only about 8 tables and while we were there it was packed with carry out orders with people waiting in the parking lot.   Clearly it was worth our wait to eat there.  The Appetizer menu is well thought out and we had the Calamari which was perfectly fried in a tempura batter, the Shrimp Blanket which is Deep fried marinated shrimp wrapped in the rice paper and garlic edamame.  One of our party had the Chada Fried Rice,  fried jasmine rice with egg, chicken, sweet sausage, bacon, cashew nut, dried grape, onion, topped with green onion, cilantro and my DIL and I each split a Tropical Island and a Dynamite Roll.  There was plenty to take for lunch the next day.  Service, despite the place being packed with eat in and take out orders, was gracious although a bit slow.  But it was well worth the wait and we will be back.  This is not your typical fast food oriental food, this is high class Thai and Vietnamese food, fresh and flavorful.   This will definitely be our go to Thai place from now on.  Warning, it is not cheap, but then, hey, you get what you pay for!
Decided to give it another try. Very good food! Above average quality Chinese fix for low cost. Service is much better & I liked the little to-go area.

We've ordered delivery from this restaurant several times in the last few months. Sometimes it's good and others I throw away most of the food. The past 2 times its been bad. Last night I threw away 2 full avocado rolls as the avocado was hard. My sons crab was also hard. It's frustrating to spend $35-40 on 5-6 rolls and throw the majority away. 
Sadly we will no longer be ordering as it's beginning to be bad more then good.
You typical ice cream parlor, definitely one of the best in the local area. It's conveniently located close to Hudson Beach, it's a an easy stop and has most flavors you would expect.

Compared to Pat's, Geno's is the lesser of the two, but I was surprised how much I enjoyed it.

I'm a big proponent of thinly sliced ribeye, but Geno's sandwich is a little more dry. Yet a big reason why I liked the steak was its provolone. The cheese was evenly layered, thickening the sandwich and providing good taste. The roll looked better at first glance, but wasn't as firm as I prefer. 

Geno's has essentially commercialized the cheesesteak with their fluorescent neon signs and flashy storefront, but it's certainly not indicative of its quality. It's a fine steak - adequate and serviceable, but doesn't come close to the smaller spots around Philly. 

If you're trying to have some fun and looking to compare steaks, Geno's and Pat's is the touristy site to hit up. You won't be having the best steak, but each have their own distinct qualities that dignify that every cheesesteak is different.

I was so looking forward to the "lunch" menu!!!! , only to find out we can't order from the lunch menu till 2:00! (How ridiculous is this!!!) I read reviews and thought this place would be something great! Well...
Not a Fan. My other half and I went with our child to try this place out since we eat at the restaurant next door all the time. Well, we made it there for the "brunch menu"- at 1:00pm. And they didn't have the lunch menu available till 2:00.(so foolish). 
 So we had to choose something from the brunch menu. I ended up getting the BLT-w fries... , my hubby had the Chx & Waffles, and our little one had the French toast, sausage, and potatoes. Let's start with the BLT ---- it wasn't anything special w one slice of wilted lettuce on each half and regular wheat bread that fell apart- and soggy fries- yeah- big disappointment and have to say it sucked!!!
(I make better BLT's at home)!!!!! 
Then the chx and waffles, they were okay nothing great either... kind of blah- and overly cooked potatoes , literally burnt potatoes. He wanted to try something different and it was a no go! Not satisfying and prob just dunked into old fry oil!!!! And lastly, the kids meal--- that wasn't a kid's portion, the scrambled eggs.... yeah it was just meh...and the sausage that is served, was just not cooked good, the potatoes--- that they served with this were basically huge chunks with no flavor.... I don't know what was even on them or how they are supposed to be served-- but they were horri

I went with a medium-sized group and none of us were impressed at all.  Granted, we opted for the buffet which is always a no-no, but we were pressed for time and already battling with a member of our party who had NO interest in trying Indian for the first time.  It's kind of sad that this was his first experience and I am pretty sure it ruined him for life.  I know better and I know where to get really tasty Indian food, and it is not here.

The restaurant was clean and the service was pretty good, I just do not think it was worth the $16 it cost for one plate of "'butter chicken" and rice.  I have had some very, very good Indian food and I have had some awful Indian food.  The awful is usually at the feed trough aka. buffet.  This was probably on the low end of "average" at best.  Particularly annoying is the obviously intentional lack of signage anywhere in the restaurant as to how much this buffet is going to be.  I did not think to ask because I am not really one who gets cheap in any way when it comes to food, but this is a "fisting" that could have easily been avoided had I known I was going to pay top dollar for this. 

In trying to describe this place I would say Minerva is to Indian food what Sonny's is to BBQ, just way more expensive.  At least after hitting the Sonny's buffet you don't leave walking funny.  

If you're dead set on going anyway, you've been warned.  As "New Tampa" has been colonized I would imagine there are probably thirty-five other Indian resta

Yesterday was the first time I ate at the Hard Rock Cafe and i was extremely impressed. The Legendary Burger was fantastic as was the Bloody Mary I ordered. By far the best part of my experience here was our server, Casey R. She was very friendly and engaged in our conversation of the music venue and the new attractions at the resort including the new entertainment venue. She definitely added to our overall experience and we will be back again soon.

Went for happy hour drinks, $5 a piece.  They weren't bad. We ordered cheese dip. Table to the left got theirs. Then table to our right got theirs. They arrived well after we did. So after 30 minutes of waiting, we asked for our check, which took the bartender forever to get to us. We put $11 on the counter as he cashed out other tickets and left to go to Juan's. We were one of three couples at the bar.

Convivo has always been one of my favorite local Santa Barbara spots to me it has one of the most BEAUTIFUL views of the ocean/beach right across the street. What's even better is that they have an Axxess deal for buy one get one free which is WELL worth it since this place is on the pricier end. I've been here for date night, work happy
hours, birthday dinners, etc and it's the perfect place for all occasions! The Bolognese
And meatballs are a MUST

Great Place for Greek Sandwiches and Apps. I'm sure dinner entrees are amazing as well. Lamb Gyro, Falafal sandwiches, dolmathes very good. Clean, friendly staff and quality food. Check Syltus out. You will love it!!

Was not impressed at all. The sandwiches are huge with lots of meat but that's pretty much it. The meat was extremely salty, to salty to eat. I ate two bites and that was it. The salami was way to much meat and had a bad after taste. The place didn't have the deli feel more of a chain feel. I was expecting a deli with homemade deserts but didn't get that. Seems like a lot of people like this place but it just wasn't for me.

I LOVE THIS PLACE! Hidden gem with great authentic Chinese food, and a really wonderful staff. We had the cucumber salad, bok choy (my favorite), soup dumplings, Dan Dan noodles, and Mongolian beef... all delicious. Highly recommend this restaurant, and I already can't wait to go back.

Honeyyyyy the chicken fried steak was worth the 600 miles I traveled to New Orleans. It was the best I've ever had. The customer service was good and it was a good atmosphere. I would recommend this place for sure.
Yes!!! As close to authentic Mexican without the plane ride.....tacos were AMAZING!!!

Great food and friendly if chaotic service. Low-key vibe in East Nashville. Not sure I really want someone else's dog drinking from a dog bowl near my feet in a covered patio attached to a main restaurant structure. At some point (I love dogs) a dining establishment should recognize the sanitation issue. Outdoor seating - no problem with this.

I definitely recommend Chulas if you'd like a good sit-down Mexican restaurant. It's got cool decor and super clean. Someday I hope to make it for the 2 for 1 margarita happy hour (2:30-5:00 everyday). The lunch burrito was plenty big for me. The pork was super tasty. The complimentary chips and salsa were great. This is WAY better than some of the other Mexican places in the area. Good service, good food!
I love Indian food and Bombay is right up there. Their chicken tikka masala is one of the best in town.

Once again five star "service" from our bartender Tracy and her manager Krista although our fries weren't perfectly hot and crispy, our food might have been a little bit cold,(they did not cook it) they still took amazing care of us and made us feel like we belong here. And they made it right
For a Saturday it was kind of slow, but after 8am it's start to pick up. As other reviewers stated the portion are huges. Not on there breakfast. They do have a great tasting coffee.

The lobster roll was to die for!!! And the house made chips were amazing!! The only thing I wish is that there was some kind of vegetable/ Cole slaw that came with the meals. Fabulous dinner overall though.

Decided to grab a bite before an appointment. I could not have chosen a better spot for a quick bite. Everything was simply delicious. Safety measures were practiced. That is my #1 priority right now!

The best Indian food I've had in santa barbara. Seriously the flavors speak for themselves and you can taste the love and quality ingredients. The wait staff is kind and gentle which is apparently rare these days. The restaurant is very simple and no bells and whistles, but focused on the delicious offerings. Thanks for the great food!

Went here for donuts after our usual spot was out. Got half a dozen donuts. $30. So despite the sticker shock, willing to keep an open mind and was willing to be open to being blown away.


The donuts aren't bad, but there aren't any donuts in the world, much less regularly sized as these, that should run this much. So the rating reflects a few things: the absurd price, limited offerings on donuts and the fact that the donut prices aren't even listed on the board along with the other items. 

Plenty of other places that you can score donuts and not drop $5 each.

Update: 8/25/19
We usually have a great experience here...not sure what happened today but this time it took forever for our food to come out. I ordered the drunken Mexican shrimp and potato crusted sea scallops. The shrimp were dry and over cooked. The scallops were tasty but arrived kind of cold. This is not the experience we've encountered in the past but this time was not a good one.  However they definitely tried to make it right. They re-made one of our dishes to take home. They also gave us some truffles and took care of our appetizers. Although it started out rough. In the end they made up for it and we were very satisfied. Coopers Hawk is still one of my favs. 
--------------------------------------------
No reservation just a spare of the moment lunch. We were greeted with a smile and seated almost immediately. I am a wine club member so the special "Thank You" bottle with lunch or dinner was a great surprise. We ordered the compSweet Red wine, one of my husbands favorite. Our waitress was nice, maybe she had too many tables at one time but she was still ok. We ordered the Thai Lettuce Wraps for an appetizer which is always one of my favs here. Although I really wanted the Mexican Drunken Shrimp but due to my husband's shellfish allergies, I decided to save that option for a girls night out.  My go to is the Jambalaya. I always get it with extra shrimp. I was a little disappointed that the shrimp were over cooked. Aside from the overcooked shrimp it was still a grea
Just called to place a pick up order and was told the kitchen was closed. Perhaps that should be listed somewhere. Hey guys we are open til 2 but we stop serving food at blank.

This place is exceptional: the service is great and the food is top notch. We had the ribeye and tuna. Perfectly prepared and delightfully seasoned. The Crown & Sin martini is one of the best I've ever had. Frankly, I'm surprised this place only has an average of 4 stars on Yelp.

My boyfriend & I just left this restaurant. They ran out of soda but the food was really good so it didn't bother me. We were enjoying our food until this older white man was talking about his ex-wives to another customer. He was saying that he had a Korean wife that no longer wants to live with the dogs that they had & he goes on to say, "honey the dogs are appetizers to you but they are pets to me." I was disgusted & it ruined my whole mood. So I hurried up & paid just so I didn't have to hear any more of his crap. It seems like he is a regular at this establishment. 

My only thing is; please make sure that your customers are comfortable in your restaurant.

Great prices for HUGE, great quality sandwiches. There is no reason to go to subway, firehouse, etc. when you can get much better sandwiches for less money at Big Stein's. If you love a good sandwich or sub, look no further.

I had asked three different sources for a good breakfast spot and all three said "Ruby Slipper". The first day when we walked up the line was down the street. Day two we arrived much earlier. There was still a line but let me tell you it was well worth the wait.

Nice job ruby
Great made-to-order doughnuts...as fresh as they get, and super tasty. Great selection too. Not the cheapest, but you're paying for the freshness...and Newtown's high rent!

This is the second location in Tampa. It is Mediterranean grille. This is their fir stand alone building with drive through. It is good use for the Coronavirus period. It created the less contact condition. 

We like their whole grilled chicken. The chicken is marinated with good spice. Chicken was butterfly opening to grilled. So it can completely grill inside the bone and outside surface. It also allow the marinated sauce with maximum exposure. The butterfly chicken is beautifully displayed. Our sides are the yellow rice and the baba ghanoush. All of them are delicious. The whole chicken is great deal all the time. 

Drive through is not most easy for this kind of food due to complicated order. Wait will be needed.

Brisket sandwich: great
Fries: great, actually taste like potatoes 
Mac and cheese: great.
The service was excellent!!! Soon as we walk in we got greeted . But the food wasn't . The oyster was 99 cent on happy hour but they were not good at all . They look good but taste terrible . No lie

The food is delicious. And going in and ordering inside is easy but going through the drive through is a pain. The workers are rude and didn't give us utensils. Once this coronavirus is over I will come back but this drive through thing bad.
Boring same run of the mill tasteless,spiceless,Chinese wanna be. Had Gen Taos chicken suck. Hot and sour sweet yuck. Guess you live and learn. Been working 65 yrs. and a lot o concerts

I placed an order online for pickup- the system gave me an estimated pick up time but not real time updates like some apps do. I really enjoyed my food- I ordered the Thai basil roll and the Beijing special combination fried rice. Both were very tasty so I would definitely order from here again!

Great BBQ joint.  Meats are exactly what you expect from a top-notch BBQ joint.  Very flavorful, and you really can't go wrong with anything you choose.  Everyone in my family has a different favorite, Ribs, turkey, brisket, pulled pork... but we like them all which is saying something when you have 4 kids.  

I like that they have some set sides, and they have special sides of the day.  Not every side works for me, but I like the variety and give them credit for trying different things, while still giving you something to count on.  WARNING: if you're like me and like baked beans that are sweet or brown sugary, these are NOT the beans you want.  In fact, I really don't like the baked beans.  But there are plenty of other sides to choose from.  TIP: Keep an eye out for the loaded tater tots, they are a daily special and come with pulled pork on them, they are almost a meal unto themselves. BONUS TIP: the kids meals are really a good size if you are working on portion control. So I either get a 4 bone rib meal and kids meal for my daughter and swap with her, or I get a half rack rib meal and split it with my daughter. DOUBLE BONUS TIP: They serve Ski soft drinks, which I really like, the fountain that you pass while standing in line at the Fenton/valley park location mixes heavier in syrup, whereas the fountain after you pay and by the condiments is more watered down.  Can definitely taste the difference on the lemonade at least.

Line can look long sometimes, but it moves fas

Excellent experience at the Italian Barrel.  Walked around til pretty late trying to find somewhere to eat, the first place we stopped had an hour wait so we continued on only to a few other choices we had looked into.  Unfortunately one was closed for vacation, one had stopped taking tables, and another was closed for renovations.  
Stumbled upon the Italian Barrel by accident and I'm so glad I did.  Although they were super busy they ran around and figured out how to accommodate us on such short notice right before closing.  I ordered the filet mignon which was garnished with pretty little flowers and could easily be cut with a spoon.  Top 5 best steaks I've had in my lifetime.  I also had my favorite (tiramisu) for dessert which was also amazing.
Excellent service from the host, to our very tentative waitress to the host again as we were leaving.  If ever in New Orleans make sure to hit the Italian Barrel up!
Great spot for a sub if your in a hurry. Most of the Subs are under 10 dollars. Great on your wallet.

First time there...and let me say loved it! The price did change is what the host told us but I didn't mine. Our server was quick and so polite, everybody else was too. Great ventilation, awesome gas grill, the food was good, everything was great. But if you are gonna go, go for dinner, its gonna be more expensive, but better selection. With everything going, the price of beef going up I can't complain on the price..$38(dinner) $26(lunch) per person. We really enjoyed the short ribs, beef belly, marinated short rib steak, Rib eye steak, and the pork belly. Go for those items, they will make the money worth it. Can't wait for another trip to Reno!

Okay so we have been coming here for a long time and always liked the food, service, and vibe.  Easier parking options around and my kids liked it as well.

The last two visits, the food has gotten noticeably salty -- every single dish has too much salt, and I think the chef is a heavy smoker and can't taste the food.
Love the food and the service of this place so fresh and tasty always it's a amazing place for vegetarians like me ....

Recently moved from NY, needed good Chinese. One of the best in Tampa! Good COVID etiquette, fast, big servings. We order once a week and they never disappoint! And we always get something cool for free!

My wife requested Bistro Napa for her birthday dinner. Service was impeccable with Sherwin taking care of us as or waiter. I went with the lamb shank with butternut risotto. And the wife went with the Halibut which was the special offering of the night. Couldn't ask for a better evening.
Cardboard pizza. Not good for you. Doesn't digest. Overpriced. Not happy. Don't think I'll be returning.

First time here today! The food was delicious and presented nicely. The people are friendly and welcoming. Not sure if we will be back though based on the prices. I feel like we can get bigger portions for less money at other yummy establishments.
I ordered my favorites from Skipolini's today. Amazing! I ordered the jalapeño appetizer and the Cajun pasta. Both were warm and fresh. They even included extra ranch and pasta sauce!

Super good burgers, perfect size. 
Ingredients were super fresh.
They have a walk up window and drive thru.
Great little spot, great service.
Food came out fast.
Only reason I dont give 5 stars its because the fries were a bit over fried to my liking.

Food was super delicious and arrived quickly.  Service was excellent. Everyone was super attentive. Space was clean and cozy with ample parking. Great experience overall and I will definitely be back. Highly recommend.

Very impressive slices. I went with two slices and when the cashier rang me up and it came to almost $10 dollars I was a little curious how it cost so much well right as I opened the box on the walk back I knew why...these slices are MASSIVE! It took some work but I managed to finish one slice and only had a few bites from the second slice.

I deducted one star for not being able to fold the pizza which made it beyond difficult trying to eat on the way home. I was leaning against post office boxes, random steps to peoples apartment, against some walls while trying to hold the box and slam a bite down of the pizza. New experience for me. I suggest you eat the pizza there.

The stuffed pizza which has a lattice pie like crust looks spectacular, along with there sicilian. I am going to take a few weeks off so is the goal but I would definitely return for one of those slices. CASH only but its quick service and they have an ATM inside.

OMG!  Finally found my go to Mexican place!  I travel all over the us and Mexico for work and I love the food.  I have been searching for an authentic place to go and this is it. 

The restaurant is attached to a Mexican store and bakery and smells like heaven when you walk in.  

They serve warm homemade chips with a little cheese and some kind of super tasty bean sauce on top.  They had me at hello!

There is a salsa and fixings bar you can help yourself to to jazz it up. But we thought they were great as is.  

We ordered a taco salad, sope, and chaulapas.  Just was so good. Planning to go back next week to explore more.  

Just go try it!

I come here a lot! Their food is great and the atmosphere is super fun - though I think the St. Pete (original) location is better quality wise, but this location is more convenient for us since we live in Tampa. The pollo asado sandwich is a must try - though I will say the last few times I have gotten it from, I have been disappointed because they use black avocado that has gone bad. :( but when it's fresh it's delicious!! We recently tried their new pollo frito sandwich, and unfortunately they completely burned the fried chicken. But despite a couple of bad experiences, I still highly recommend this place for yummy Cuban/Latin American cuisine!

Quick service and wonderful atmosphere. It's a bit loud so if you want an intimate dinner to hear one another this is not it. The food was delicious, authentic, and filling. The portions were a decent size some larger than others. The crawfish beignet was fantastic and highly recommended. The bread pudding for desert also another wonderful piece to end the meal.
One of the most friendly staff experiences I've ever had. And amazing Ethiopian food on the weekends to top it off
Food was great!! Service was great!! Waitress (Mina) was great and beautiful looking as well. I would recommend her all the time for our waitress .

I would give 3.5 if I could, the first time I ate here with my vegetarian mom I would have easily given it 4 for sure, my most recent visit however was not so great. We each has a cupcake (non-vegan) banana pudding, they were moist and delicious and quickly eaten. The place was 3/4 full and we placed a to-go order for a single burger, when I asked the cashier how long it would take, she  responded "20 minutes" I was slightly taken aback and as I was in a hurry but  decided to continue because as long as I was back in my car in 25 I would be on time. After 23 minutes of waiting, the staff seemed annoyed and inconvenienced by my inquiry and simply told me it would be ready "soon" once 30 minutes had gone by I told them we had to leave and could they please refund my money, a girl ran back to the kitchen and came back saying my order was being packaged up, and two minutes later I had my food along with a very unapologetic sorry from one of the girls there. Either they have  one single incredibly slow cook in the back or misplaced my order, either way I will not be returning. The first time we went and ate in, it was much busier, we had to wait to get seats, and still had a three meal order in under 15 minutes.

So, I read a new post on here about a lady complaining about how she was asked to remove a cup she brought in from outside the restaurant.  My first question is why would you bring a drink into a place of business that serves drinks as part of their business?  If it is needed for medical reasons which I highly doubt it ever is, ask while you are waiting for your seat if you can have it.  There is a sign on the door, stop back by and look harder.
In her post she says the food is consistent and I assume good since they ate there twice a week and brought new customers and friends to eat with them.
A one star post because she was asked to remove a cup, just shows how petty customers can be.  The owner is busy and doesn't have time to come ask for you to remove a cup you should not of had there in the first place.  You find it rude, the owner told the server taking care of you to mention it and asked you to do so.  Why wouldn't you be the better person and when finished ask to speak to him or her and apologize for bringing a cup in.  Tell her it wouldn't happen again?  I have been eating here for years and never have I see the owners be rude to the employees, this must just be another stab because your feelings were hurt.  
I can guarantee you, you won't be missed, they have plenty of great customers that keep coming back.  Great food, great people and just a great place to sit down and have a good big meal.
I am sorry for your loss, let us know the next time your favorite restaur
Great food and great service! Khoi was our waiter and did a great job. Definitely added this place as one of my favs when I visit the STL area!!!

Unique place. Food is fantastic and fresh! You place your order at the window, receive great customer service from Juan (very kind and personable) then take your seat until your name is called. They have a huge menu available for your convenience and at least 4 large screen tv's. They feature a covered patio and a separate outdoor space under the stars.

I've been a customer since Bobacup opened in 2015 and never has my order been a disappointment. Staff is always friendly and informative, prices have remained fair , drinks are always delicious. The owner, Nam is very hands on with this family owned business even though he has 2 more businesses in Gainesville. Not only is his his marketing inventive and refreshing , this was the only boba place to open during the Covid pandemic . Providing hope and fuel for people like me , who depend on mid day picker uppers. Ordering online was easy and drinks were delivered curbside promptly. 2 full sized drinks for $10 is a better price than any other boba place in Tampa . The one time my son ordered a galaxy looking drink that was physically appealing but a bit of a kick for his taste , the staff replaced it with no questions or issues. Happy bosses make for happy employees! Will continue to be back as long as Bobacup is open .

Looks like i found my new favorite brunch spot on the east side! (If they haven't sold out of food.) 
I came by for the grand opening and was greeted by smiling faces and delicious horchata-coffee. The staff was very accommodating when I asked a million questions. they helped my friend and i find the perfect dishes: wings and waffles and huevos rancheros. The wings were crispy and light and had some kind of sweet, teriyaki-style flavor to them. they were served on top of a golden brown cornbread waffle (YUM!). The best part by far was the hot honey that was drizzled right over top. 
As for the huevos rancheros, the tostada was crunchy, the eggs perfectly runny, the enchilada sauce wasn't too spicy either! I love sauces and was delightfully pleased to drown my eggs and beans with their delicious, homemade salsa. 
I tried to come back around 1:45 PM on saturday and they were closed because they ran out of food!
So I made sure to get here early this morning, around 8 am and was able to get my hands on the coveted Papas Gordos. This delectable, vegetarian, messy dish was absolutely fabulous. this cheesey, gooey, saucy plate is definitely a winner. From what i've seen, they still have a few kinks to work out in their system.. but if you'd like some homemade, delicious food that's made with tons of love, give them a try with an open mind and a little bit of patience. best of luck to you all, SBC!

The bar was super clean and had a very good drink selection, which is important for a bar. Maybe if I were only reviewing their drinks, this review would be higher. I actually didn't even have a drink that morning. I would go back for a try if the opportunity arises. There was also a nice selection of games to play and open patio seating. All of the employees were attentive and super-nice. There were also plenty of TVs to catch any game that could happen to be on. 

So now on to the food. For a place that appears to pride themselves on burgers, they should switch to a more fresh patty. These seem to be the Sam's choice frozen patties. Not the best quality of meat. Burger was overcooked, but I think that's the only way to cook a frozen patty. The bun was ok. Neither very fresh, nor stale. Just a standard tasting piece of bread. The fries had a nice seasoning on them,  but they were overpowered by the taste of old oil. Needless to say, I wasn't impressed with their burgers. Maybe I'll go back for a drink and give another menu item a try.
Had the best brunch. The eggs Benedict was so yummy. Our waiter Thais recommended the best drinks and truly made our experience the best! The pork roll sandwich was also delicious. 10/10 must go

Sad experience.  The food can be good, but the sevice and ambiance was awful. We did not get waited on when we sat down for at least 10 min. Then we ordered a couple of glasses of wine, they took 15 min more, the app came out before our drink. Totally unorganized.  We left without ordering dinner.

Brunch is my favorite meal of the day, so I'm always on the lookout for a new option to potentially add to my "Top ten NOLA Brunch list".  Fullblast was very good, but didn't quite make the cut.  They excelled in the key areas of cleanliness, fast, friendly service, COVID-safe, hearty servings and decent mimosas.  Where they slightly missed the mark, in my humble opinion, is in creativity and putting out a truly memorable brunch experience.  The avocado toast and the western omelette were both good, but nothing special.  The breakfast potatoes were okay.  The toast was so-so.  

If you're in the neighborhood and looking for a quick and filling meal, give Fullblast a try, but if you're after an experience that will leave you checking your calendar for your next opportunity to visit and take your out-of-town guests, you can do better at a handful of places.  I'd put them on par with newer Ruby Slippers that have popped up all over town, but not even close to Elizabeth's or Atchafalaya.
Great beer section and fries are featured on Food network but I'd like a thicker cut and make sure they're fresh every serving - decent flavors but not enough heat

Okay! So yesterday my friend at work and I were talking for a little over an hour about food places. She mentioned how soon as you walk into Sardi's the smell hits you in the face. She said it's a little pricey but the food is worth it and they give you a lot. I couldn't wait to get off of work because I knew what I was feeding my family for dinner. She did NOT lie! Mannnn listen! That smell made my mouth water. The staff was very helpful when helping me order. I was a little bummed that they didn't have the mumbo sauce. I was looking forward to trying it. I had ordered the whole chicken with corn and mashed potatoes. $25 well spent! It was so hard driving home without trying to eat a piece of chicken. It was so good my daughter asked could she take leftovers for lunch. Looks like this will be our new spot.
This is my new favorite spot for vegetarian restaurant choice. I usually order spicy rice noodle soup, and it's really great. The restaurant is really near to my school. Love it.

By far the best Chinese food that I've gotten in Tampa. I go out of my way to go to this place and have been coming here for 5 years now. They are always so nice and fast and the food is clean and good.

What a perfect place to order from for a socially distanced meal outside with friends. The girl taking the order was perfect, food was perfect and delivery was perfect! Add a bottle of wine & s'mores & you've got a perfect evening!

First time eating their food, was wanting Chinese so ordered through Postmates. I got an appetizer of rangoons and the lunch special honey chicken with an egg roll and fried rice. The rangoons are on more of the savory side so if you prefer the sweeter ones then I don't recommend these for you. They're pretty good for savory ones.  The honey chicken is really sweet, hence the name . It was really good I add a little chili garlic sauce I had at home to it and it was superb. The fried rice was oily tasting, not the greatest fried rice but when everything is combined it's good. The egg roll was a good egg roll. I will try them again and see if I can up there star rating from a 4 to a 5 on my review.

If I were the Gonzmart's I would take my name off of this place or close this rip-off of an airport restaurant.  15 minute wait for luke-warm fries and a smushed grilled cheese on thin bread with barely any cheese on it.  $15 down the drain...now I know why the other places had many people in line and  Goody Goody only had 2 of us ordering.
I have been waiting for them to re-open during Pandemic and now I can finally have some nice pho. They renovated store so it's cleaner and looks better than before. Food still tasted good.
Only have had take out.  Every time it's spot on. Honey Almond Chicken is the best.  Gluten free options for nearly everything.

Ambiance - 5
Food - 3
= Overall score of 4

Cute little spot in historical area of town.  It does remind you of an old tavern.  They serve lots of hearty, homey dishes - including homey deserts such as banana bread pudding and apple crisp.

I thought my food was so-so. Their Caesar Rodney was really enjoyable.  After all the excitement around the pot pie, I was excited to try- and I think I was oversold.  It was rich - in a strange way - with very little beef.  The peach cobbler was disappointing- I wished for a crunch and I got a sponge cake on the bottom.

Visiting New Orleans, you have to visit this restaurant! It's not your typical old world place, but a modern sleek decor. The  menu is primarily small plates for sharing and a small selection of really good entrees. The wine list is respectable with enough choices to please.

Service was good , it was clean and we had a blast! My suggestion is to come with an open mind and let the server make your choices!

Don't miss this spot!

WOKE UP TO A STRANGE MAN IN OUR ROOM IN THE MIDDLE OF THE NIGHT- OMNI SECURITY DID NOTHING! YOU ARE NOT SAFE HERE!!

Omni Nashville Security is negligent, rude and told us "these things happen" when we woke up to a strange man in our room (he was in our room for 25+ minutes while we were sleeping!!) Two police reports have been filed and Omni said they would follow up, but have not. It's a nightmare situation made worse by Omni's lack of urgency, negligence- could not imagine how this situation could be handled worse!

My girlfriend and I woke up to a stranger in a hooded sweatshirt holding his flashlight lit cellphone over my bed at 2:30am. I immediately and intensely told him to leave. After trying to hide in our bathroom and me getting up to plead with him to, "please, leave," he finally complied. We immediately called the Omni security team who took more than 30 min to arrive, and lied twice saying they did not have security cameras that would be helpful to us, leaving the intruder plenty of time to get away. Hotel security also said they could not provide us with the peace of mind of who the hooded man might be, they even suggested it was our fault because our door must have been open. We were told to "calm down" and "these things happen." 

FURIOUS at the reaction to an unknown man being in our room, we called local police and additionally had an outside security team with our company get involved only to find out that there were indeed security cameras that were extrem
love the sweet burger  also love the mac and cheese!! SweetArt is a truly wonderful place!

This spot is ridiculously amazing, but let me tell you, our server AJ made it through the roof! He kept us laughing from the time we walked in the door, till we took pics with him, and said we would be back before we leave town.  The chicken had just enough kick to it, that when you pair it with the honey... OMG... you have just seen baby Jesus it's so good! Every side we had was just as amazing.  The sweet tea is so sweet, AJ has nicknamed it the ghetto punch, and wow! Talk about a diabetic coma, just like AJ said, but you can't stop drinking it.  If I could get them 10* I would, because they honestly deserve 100! Can't wait to go back, and laugh some more!

This sushi is amazing. Very fresh, very delicious. Has all the traditional dishes plus some delicious specialty rolls. Amazing service! Owner and family are so welcoming, expedient, and kind. Truly, all around incredible experience.

Found this place by chance as I was craving for sushi and Vic Sushi Bar was the closest sushi place nearby. The place had good food options for an affordable price. My friend and I ordered Sansom roll, Ocean Brother roll, Tiger roll, Vic Sushi roll and Salmon (Sake) sashimi. The food and service was ok but wasn't as good as other places that I've tried, but for the price I couldn't complain much. The place is small though so that's a drawback since you might have to wait a bit if you come with a party of more than 2. Overall, it's a good place if you're looking for a quick and affordable sushi bite.
Nest cheesesteak i have had in years.  Roll does not get soggy. Even next day on reheat the roll stood up.  AWESOME!!

Pizza was really good. I did a custom pizza with shrimp and bacon. Shrimp was perfect not overcooked fresh and flavorful and was in big pieces. The bacon was perfect too crisp and not greasy. Delivery was fast to my door. This is my go to place now for pizza.

Went in about 30 min after they opened. Employee was nice and friendly. Ordered 12 cookies. Waited a minute or two, got the cookies and was on my way. Cookies were SO GOOD! They were warm and soft. They still taste wonderful the next day, too. Very happy with my visit and will be back soon! Wish there was a location in st Charles county :(

Saw the place on here and decided to stop for lunch. Doesn't look like a 5 star place but PLEASE go in and eat!  I had a gyro and coke special along with Dolma stuffed grape leaves. Get the grape leaves hot, your taste buds will thank you. Very friendly, slower paced place, sit down and enjoy the food. Some of the best grape leaves I've ever had. Stop in and try something and you'll probably come back!

My favorite tiki bar in New Orleans.  The drink menu has a good variety of different tiki drinks and the food is really tasty.  I had the wings, which were delicious and came with a tasty dipping sauce.
The environment is pretty cool. I wasn't too pleased with the food. It's greasy with not a lot of flavor. It looks better than it taste.

This was a happy little find! Between the unbelievable (also not expensive!!) food and the incredible opera singing from the amazing talented wait staff. This restaurant made my birthday dinner and try special event. I will definitely be back. If you're put off by the opera singing, don't be, it's a welcome experience and not at all intrusive to your dining experience.

Looking for a pretty dessert to bring home and impress your parents for the holidays? This is a perfect place to go! I may be a weirdo, but I have to admit that I love coming here to look at all the desserts. Everything just simply looks divine. I've had some of their smaller pastries, like the croissants, and some of the smaller desserts, and they've all been delicious. Haven't gotten a chance to try any of the larger cakes yet, but as I said before, they all look amazing. Very impressed by this place and can't wait to try more!

The food and service was excellent. Gluten free good choices I think we'll maybe pizza and dairy free cheese but. Grilled octopus and the lamb chops was very tasty. I will return for a nice date night with my wife. My wife love the tiramisu.

Cheesecake Factory usually is very good which is why I gave them 3 stars... but I just had the lettuce wraps delivered through Doordash and the lettuce was very dirty, and looked old. The rest of the order was very good, but ended up tossing the lettuce part of the lettuce wrap... that being said, I will be visiting this establishment again.

Just my third 1 Star Review on Yelp and this Popeyes location deserves it 100%. To start this place is filthy from the customer section to the sloppiness behind the counter. 

The sweet heat sauce at this location is almost always out of stock BUT they magically will give you some portioned in their own disposable cup. Hmmm weird, gross , and no thx!!

We were pumped to try the new chicken sandwich but knew this location will probably disappoint us. We risked it and went on a Friday night and arrived at 7:45 pm. There were only 3 people ahead of us and about 5 behind us when we went to order. 

I wanted one original and one spicy but plain. No mayo/sauce/pickles. I was turned away Bc they said they had pre made the rest of the sandwiches until close. Hmmm ok?! Then he followed up with this location only serves them how they come.. ok enjoy it I will take my business else where. 

I see no management responds to this location... wonder why.. wonder how this dirty location is still in business.

This restaurant located near Citrus Park Mall at the  corner of Ehrlich Rd and Gunn Hwy. I was there at lunch time and I ordered a crab soup and a dozen raw oysters. I didn't find chunk of crab meat and the menu said it was snow crab, so the meat was probably dissolved in the soup. It wasn't particular delicious but it was creamy and filled my stomach. The oysters that I truly loved. The fresh, cold oyster with horseradish and cocktail sauce slided through my mouth and throat, it was a fun sensation and personal feast for me. Thursday got special price for oyster. The size ranged from medium to large, such a good deal. This restaurant and bar offered good service, decent seafood. It's worth the drive.

Checked out the new Brick & Brew in Havertown with the family last night. Very Center City vibe to the design of the place. Best described as upscale pub food. Right in the heart of Havertown on Eagle Road. Was formally the Oakmont Pub.

I had the burger special which had shaved pork belly, gouda cheese and a grilled green tomato served on a croissant which was somewhat unique. I ordered it medium and it came out more on the well side. Overall an interesting take on the burger. I would give it a 3 out of 5. The rest of the family ordered pizza: four cheese pizza (daughter), spicy sausage pizza (son), wild mushroom pizza (wife). My wife and son gave their pizzas a thumbs up. I tried my wife's and would give it a solid 4 out of 5 as it was served with three kinds of mushrooms, goat cheese and pesto. Very good. My daughter's pizza came out a good seven minutes after all of our food was served which was disappointing. An alert manager noticed the situation and proactively came to our table to provide an update. It turned out the pizza was not up to the B&B quality standard so they started a new one for her. We were provided another update as apparently the second pizza they made for her was a dud so they finally got it right on the third time. I certainly appreciate them not serving a pizza that was not to their standard of quality. My daughter was expecting the pizza to be a red pizza but the four cheese pizza is a white pizza. So I'm still trying to figure out WHY People wait in line for this place. Seriously NOT worth it. Luckily We only had to wait in line for about 15 mins.
